name: ActivityNet-QA
intro: ActivityNet-QA 是 Gemma 3 报告中使用的视频问答 benchmark，用于评估模型对视频活动和事件的理解。
build_method: ActivityNet视频, 众包标注, 质量清洗
eval_feature: 视频问答, 长视频理解, 时空推理
build_method_en: ActivityNet videos, crowdsourced annotation, quality cleaning
eval_feature_en: Video QA, long-video understanding, spatio-temporal reasoning
intro_en: ActivityNet-QA is a video QA benchmark used by the Gemma 3 report to evaluate understanding of video activities and events.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Start from ActivityNet videos"] --> B["Select 5,800 complex web videos"]
    B["Select 5,800 complex web videos"] --> C["Crowdsource human QA annotation"]
    C["Crowdsource human QA annotation"] --> D["Build 58,000 QA pairs"]
    D["Build 58,000 QA pairs"] --> E["Pre/post-process for quality"]
    E["Pre/post-process for quality"] --> F["Analyze dataset statistics"]
    F["Analyze dataset statistics"] --> G["Compare VideoQA baselines"]
    G["Compare VideoQA baselines"] --> H["Report accuracy"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1906.02467 and the MILVLG/activitynet-qa repository. The paper derives 5,800 complex web videos from ActivityNet, creates 58,000 fully human-annotated QA pairs, performs dataset analysis and quality processing, and evaluates VideoQA baselines with accuracy on long-video understanding.
